synopsisParagraphs: The street of Hope cuts through the city like a scar, severed by a cage of titanium mesh. To the West lies the pinnacle of human ingenuity. To the East lie a gated community of the unneeded, the unwanted and the unnecessary.

From humble beginnings, Ezra is the most powerful man in the West. He is the founder of ENIGMA; a bioengineering company that commodifies the human experience. The company champions a controversial drug that allows its users to relive their most meaningful memories at the cost of losing them forever. Ezra conquered the world, only to find the success he chased was nothing more than  a mirage.

Lily fell from grace to become one of the folks of the East. Once a perpetual optimist, she’s been broken by domestic abuse and violence on the city streets. She is the living collateral damage of the empire Ezra built, surviving in the shadows of his skyline.

Separated by chains and choices, the two unexpectedly meet in a local coffee shop. As Ezra confronts the hollowness of his ambition and Lily buckles under the weight of her survival - they are both forced to confront the same question. In a world broken by inequality and indifference, is the only way to survive the present to execute the past?
